svg.title: Hexbin map
svg.desc: The Netherlands covered in a grid of equal hexagons, shaded in four teal classes by the number of recorded incidents. The darkest hexagons are around Amsterdam and Rotterdam; hexagons with no incidents are white with a grey outline.
